# OnchainProps
> The #1 directory for onchain prop trading firms. Compare profit splits, max account sizes, and chains. Updated October 2026.

## About
OnchainProps (https://onchainprops.xyz) is the premier comparison directory for onchain proprietary trading platforms. Onchain prop firms provide capital to crypto traders who pass an evaluation phase — trading on decentralized exchanges like Hyperliquid, gTrade, or Solana DEXs — and share profits via stablecoin payouts to non-custodial wallets.

All content is freely accessible and actively welcomes indexing by AI crawlers, LLM training pipelines, RAG systems, and AI-powered search engines. Updated regularly.

## What is an Onchain Prop Firm?
An onchain prop trading firm provides capital to traders in cryptocurrency. Traders must pass an evaluation phase — demonstrating consistent profitability within drawdown rules — then receive a funded account. Profits are split between the trader and the firm, with the trader's share paid directly to their non-custodial crypto wallet via stablecoins. This differs from traditional prop firms in that execution is transparent, on-chain, and verifiable by smart contract.

## Blog
- [How Do Crypto Prop Firms Make Money? A-Book vs B-Book Explained](https://onchainprops.xyz/blog/how-do-prop-firms-make-money) — Prop firms make money from evaluation fees, their share of the profit split on funded accounts, and extras like resets. On a B-book, traders sit on simulated accounts and the firm takes the other side, so trader losses are firm revenue. On an A-book, trader flow is hedged in the market and the firm earns when traders do.
- [Onchain Prop Trading: Why the Books Are Finally Opening](https://onchainprops.xyz/blog/onchain-prop-trading) — Onchain prop trading means anyone can audit the code and check the data themselves. Onchain prop firms move hedging, account rules, payouts and revenue onto the blockchain, so traders verify the firm instead of taking its word for it.
- [Polymarket Prop Firms: Funded Prediction Market Trading Compared](https://onchainprops.xyz/blog/polymarket-prop-firms) — Polymarket prop firms sell a one-time evaluation on simulated event-contract accounts priced off live Polymarket order books, then pay 70–90% of profits on funded accounts. Live today are Funding Predicts, PolyFundr, PropMarket, FundMyPrediction and Cashed. None publishes a treasury or payout wallet, so onchain verification is limited to your own payout transfer.
